review.recipe: Small footed 180ml goblet; dissolved sugar in brown-black Irish coffee, level softly aerated ivory oat cream to rim, no grains/garnish/ice. Cream not piped.
review.personality: Both coats now adjacent directly behind drink, with a used towel close below; equal welcome readable without airport or impossible steam. Narrow-phone edges trim coat hems/towel but both distinct fabrics and adjacent hooks survive.
review.world: One right practical lamp, dark worn walnut, near-black neutral wood; removed left fixtures/open room. No industrial surface or uniform orange shadows.
